# CAPABILITY MATRIX — v0.5.0

Status: IMPLEMENTED (works, tested) · PARTIAL (works within stated limits) · EXPERIMENTAL (written, only partly verified) · MOCK · PLANNED · UNAVAILABLE.
"Tested" = automated tests on **synthetic** artwork / files generated by this project. **No real embroidery artwork, sew-out, third-party
reader, machine, Wilcom installation, GPU or SAM 2 checkpoint was available in the build sandbox.**

| Feature | Status | Tested | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| PNG / JPG / WEBP input | IMPLEMENTED | yes | content sniffing (not extension), corrupt-file detection |
| SVG input (curves, transforms, groups, holes, strokes) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | exact geometry, no rasterisation of the outline; gradients/CSS/text/clip/use are rejected or warned, never flattened silently |
| AI input | PARTIAL | yes | only PDF-compatible AI with plain path operators; otherwise `AI_FILE_UNSUPPORTED_VARIANT` (no screenshot fallback) |
| Vision V2 (background, holes, widths, centerline, anti-alias) | IMPLEMENTED | yes (synthetic) | |
| SAM / SAM 2 segmentation | EXPERIMENTAL / optional | fallback + mask clean-up tested; **model path NOT exercised** | needs torch + sam2 + checkpoint; otherwise falls back to Standard and says so |
| Mask clean-up → topology repair → objects | IMPLEMENTED | yes | used by any mask provider |
| Semantic classification | PARTIAL, heuristic | yes | stem/branch/leaf/petal/text/eye(candidate)/decoration/small-detail/background; not a trained model; misclassifies (see demo) |
| Semantic hierarchy (Bird > Head > Eye) | PLANNED | – | only geometric containment/occlusion hierarchy exists |
| Occlusion continuation (hidden branch) | PARTIAL, heuristic | yes | flagged for review |
| Run / triple run | IMPLEMENTED | yes | bean stitch, directional run: PLANNED |
| Satin column / satin ring | IMPLEMENTED | yes | single column or concentric ring; branched satin PLANNED (falls back to fill, recorded) |
| Tatami / complex fill (holes, angle, stagger) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | complex_fill = same generator; multi-angle, density variation, patterned fill PLANNED |
| Underlay (center/edge/zigzag/double-zigzag/tatami) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| Appliqué | PARTIAL | yes | placement → STOP → tack → STOP → satin border; holes handled; values unvalidated |
| 3D puff | PARTIAL | yes | base → STOP(foam) → perforation → dense cover → border; warns on narrow/sparse/large; foam behaviour unvalidated |
| Cross stitch | PARTIAL | yes | grid/fabric count, X stitch, row method; half-stitch PLANNED |
| Gradient / shading | PARTIAL | yes | banded colour steps + per-band density; not continuous tone; not wired into automatic recommendations |
| Stitch path + validator (15 checks) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| Connector: hidden A* routing, jump/trim cost, edge-walk | PARTIAL | yes | grid A*; visibility graph PLANNED; concave fills still jump a lot |
| Sequence: hard constraints then optimisation | IMPLEMENTED | yes | greedy, not globally optimal |
| QC rules (jumps/trims/colours/travel/short/long/density/fabric) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| Auto-repair (propose → simulate → re-QC → approve) | PARTIAL | yes | 4 repairs; never applies without approval; reports NO_EFFECT / REJECTED_BY_QC honestly |
| Reference comparison (coverage, contour chamfer, topology, size, centroid) | PARTIAL | yes | semantic correspondence PLANNED |
| Thread palettes + CIEDE2000 + colorways | IMPLEMENTED (engine) | yes (published test values) | **no brand data shipped**; generic 24-colour palette + CSV import |
| Madeira / Isacord / Gunold codes | UNAVAILABLE (licensing) | – | import your licensed CSV |
| Fabric profiles (11) + push-pull model | PARTIAL | yes | heuristic, confidence capped <0.9, not fitted to sew-outs |
| Hoop / design-bounds check | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| DST export + read-back verification | IMPLEMENTED | yes | |
| EXP export + read-back verification | EXPERIMENTAL | yes (own reader only) | |
| PES export | UNAVAILABLE | – | needs Brother colour table + thumbnail block |
| JEF export | UNAVAILABLE | – | needs Janome colour table |
| Native EMB generation / editing | UNAVAILABLE (`EMB_API_NOT_CONFIGURED`) | interface + gating tested | no supported Wilcom route configured; no fake files |
| Canonical design model (.ecd.json) | IMPLEMENTED | yes | open JSON, not EMB |
| Web dashboard (stdlib server, drag & drop, tabs, approval gate) | IMPLEMENTED | API + JS syntax tested; **not viewed in a real browser in the sandbox** | React/FastAPI: PLANNED (same JobManager) |
| Interactive SAM2 click/refine in GUI | PLANNED | – | endpoint reports unavailable |
| Simulation (path, thread, playback) | PARTIAL, labelled SIMULATION | yes | Puff/appliqué/cross not visually differentiated |
| Command parser → structured intent | PARTIAL | yes | parse only, never executes |
| Wilcom mock adapter | MOCK | yes | |
| Wilcom ES-65 / E4 real automation | UNAVAILABLE / PLANNED | interface only | |
| Learning engine | PLANNED | – | SewOutRecord schema exists |
| Sew-out validation / datasets | NOT DONE | – | needs real data |

## Performance (this sandbox, CPU only, 8-object synthetic reference; SAM 2 not available so not benchmarked)
| size | objects | vision | blueprint+semantics | technical | stitch+seq+conn | validate | compare | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 512x512 | 8 | 0.811s | 0.024s | 0.001s | 0.289s | 0.084s | 0.268s | 1.496s |
| 768x768 | 8 | 2.212s | 0.026s | 0.001s | 0.302s | 0.09s | 0.315s | 2.967s |
| 1024x1024 | 8 | 2.13s | 0.024s | 0.001s | 0.281s | 0.086s | 0.278s | 2.824s |
| 1600x1600 | 8 | 1.971s | 0.025s | 0.001s | 0.324s | 0.091s | 0.293s | 2.744s |
| 3000x3000 | 8 | 2.188s | 0.026s | 0.001s | 0.292s | 0.092s | 0.32s | 3.024s |

Images are analysed at ≤768 px on the long side, so time is flat above that.
